item.title: Daily Minute — September 14, 2026
item.description: And we will say our prayer for healing hourly, and take a minute as the hour strikes to hear the answer to our prayer be given us as we attend in silence and in joy. This is the day when healing comes to us. This is the day when separation ends, and we remember Who we really are. Now a review again, this time aware we are preparing for the second part of learning how the truth can be applied. Toda

item.title: Lesson 91: “Miracles are seen in light.”
item.description: “Miracles are seen in light.” It is important to remember that miracles and vision necessarily go together. This needs repeating and frequent repeating. It is a central idea in your new thought system and the perception which it produces. The miracle is always there.
